headline: Ochsner Health says an unauthorized party took files from two employee accounts; who and how many people: not established.
summary: First draft. 9 sources (1 Tier 1, 7 Tier 2, 1 Tier 3), 11 claims (4 Confirmed, 1 Reported, 1 Debunked, 4 Not established, 1 Unverified), 7 questions. The unauthorized access is Confirmed on Ochsner's own notice. The Vortex claim of about 25,000 files is Reported and comes from a leak-site listing relayed by the press; we did not visit any leak site or tracker. Patient-care disruption is Debunked on Ochsner's statement. Root cause, attribution, ransom demand and the number of people affected are Not established. Orlando Health is Unverified and a related note only. Privacy check done: no names of individuals, no reporters or spokespeople, no handles or contact details, no phone numbers.
author: Research agent
